experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r22, 8; st.d $r22, $r20, 0; li.d $r22, -8; st.d $r22, $r20, 8; li.d $r21, 0' --asm 'fldx.d $f0, $r20, $r21; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'
experiments.notes: rj -> fd chain; the movfr2gr.d (3) + add.d (1) closure is subtracted.

latencies.notes: rj -> fd chain; the movfr2gr.d (3) + add.d (1) closure is subtracted.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r22, 8; st.d $r22, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0' --asm 'fldx.d $f0, $r20, $r4; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; andi $r4, $r4, 7'
experiments.notes: rk -> fd chain with the index loop-carried and masked; the movfr2gr.d (3) + andi (1) closure is subtracted.

latencies.notes: rk -> fd chain with the index loop-carried and masked; the movfr2gr.d (3) + andi (1) closure is subtracted.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fldx.d $f0, $r20, $r4; fldx.d $f1, $r20, $r5; fldx.d $f2, $r20, $r6; fldx.d $f3, $r20, $r7; fldx.d $f4, $r20, $r8; fldx.d $f5, $r20, $r9; fldx.d $f6, $r20, $r10; fldx.d $f7, $r20, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56' --asm 'fldx.d $f0, $r20, $r4; fldx.d $f1, $r20, $r5; fldx.d $f2, $r20, $r6; fldx.d $f3, $r20, $r7; fldx.d $f4, $r20, $r8; fldx.d $f5, $r20, $r9; fldx.d $f6, $r20, $r10; fldx.d $f7, $r20, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: L1D-hit indexed floating-point load; base and index paths are recorded separately.
